gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-1p: Confident, tightly knit rows come from Oswald in the heading. Give M PLUS 1p a little extra size and its open curve ends keep the sans text comfortable beside that tight heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 has a gaping c opening and a fixed nib width throughout. But Oswald is tightly knit and strong, and that dense-versus-open gap is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Oswald packs its rows tightly and speaks with confidence. M PLUS Code Latin, constant-width neon tubing bent into letters, with pitcher-wide c mouths, makes text feel approachable line after line.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-metrophobic: Oswald sets confident, tightly knit rows that look strong from the first line. And Metrophobic lets the eye glide around each bend, so extended reading feels modern and clean.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-mingzat: Tight, strong rows meet loose, curvy letters in this pairing. Oswald brings confident, tightly knit density, while Mingzat's unclamped curves give its plain sans text room to move.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-molengo: Molengo reads crisp, with wide gaps that hold up at tiny sizes. Against Oswald's confident, tightly knit rows, that plain sans openness is the quality that makes the pairing work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-momo-trust-sans: Tight and forceful on top, open and friendly just below it. That split is the best thing here: Oswald packs tight rows, while Momo Trust Sans gives bowls and stems matching weight.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-monda: Tightly knit rows give Oswald its strong, confident look right away. Monda, with unclogged small counters, keeps text approachable and clean from the first paragraph to the very last.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-mooli: Mooli uses open round letters that stay legible at small sizes. Against Oswald's confident, tightly knit rows, that open roundness is the best thing about the pair and the reason they sit together.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and clean, its s curves opening wide at both ends so every line stays easy on the eye. Oswald's tight, confident rows give the sans-serif text a strong anchor.
